source: Extracted from the published release archive and verified before vendoring. Never copied from a sibling protocol checkout.

deliberately_not_vendored.conformance/reference/: The protocol's reference provider. CBR writes its own implementation and its own test controls; the reference is not a library to depend on.
deliberately_not_vendored.conformance/independent/: The protocol's independent Python provider, for the same reason.
deliberately_not_vendored.conformance/thirdparty/: Client-only third-party consumers. Only minimal-executor/ is vendored, because composition fixture thirdparty-kernel-enforces-required-claim-boundary launches it (M3a), together with common/combraton_client.py, the one module kernel.py imports from its sibling common/ directory; the kernel cannot start without it. minimal-publisher/ and the rest of the directory are not vendored.
deliberately_not_vendored.conformance/participants/: Descriptors for the protocol's own participants. CBR writes its own descriptor.

vendored_from_archive_notes.conformance/thirdparty/: Vendored at M3a, 2026-09-17, from the same verified release extraction; checked against BUNDLE-SHA256SUMS by scripts/verify_pin.py like every other vendored file.
